other_conditions: Applicant must be pursuing an M.Phil, Ph.D, or D.Litt. course from a recognized university in India.
Applicants who have received this scholarship three times are ineligible.
Applicant must not be a beneficiary of any other fellowship or scholarship scheme.
Applicant must not be an employee of any government or semi‑government establishment.
benefits_summary: Recipients receive cash awards and financial aid to support their research work and complete their studies.
